predeclared.purpose: Decompose fixed-history auxiliary representation drift into coordinate alignment and decoded forecast drift; four ephemeral CPU updates, no production change

alignment.decoded_features: prior-mean forecast of four future actions, using the same filtered past; real sensed components only

interpretation: A fitted general affine correction removes most of the measured policy drift on separate environment histories.
